shorts.topic: Checking one phone notification before bed turns into staying up way too late

shorts.payoff: MY PHONE: COOL. SEE YOU TOMORROW MORNING.

shorts.description: Ever check one notification before bed and suddenly your sleep schedule is gone? One tiny glance somehow becomes a full scrolling session. How often does your phone steal your bedtime? Drop it in the comments and subscribe for more relatable laughs. #phone #bedtime #scrolling #relatable #funny #everydaylife

shorts.topic: Saying you'll check your phone for five minutes before bed and suddenly it's an hour later
shorts.setup: ME: JUST 5 MINUTES ON MY PHONE...
shorts.title: Just 5 Minutes on My Phone 😂 #Shorts
shorts.description: You get into bed and promise yourself just five minutes on your phone. Somehow five minutes has its own timezone after midnight. What time did you actually put your phone down last night? #phone #sleep #bedtime #relatable #funny #everydaylife

shorts.topic: Getting a 'quick call?' message exactly when you're about to finish work

shorts.topic: Opening the fridge again like new food might have appeared since the last check
